title: Assam PWD Highway Maintenance Modernisation: From Reactive Windshield Surveys to Real-Time AI Diagnostics

title: Standardized Pavement Distress Taxonomy & ASTM D6433 / IRC:82 Condition Rating Spectrum
section: Section 2 & 7: Pavement Distress Engineering & Data Schema
prompt: A master technical reference infographic in 16:9 widescreen format on a clean white blueprint background with technical gridlines illustrating STANDARDIZED PAVEMENT DISTRESS TAXONOMY & ASTM D6433 / IRC:82 CONDITION RATING SPECTRUM. The header displays bold dark navy typography AUTOMATED HIGHWAY PAVEMENT DISTRESS CLASSIFICATION with subtitle Aligning Deep Learning Computer Vision with Indian Roads Congress Maintenance Codes. The visual layout features six distinct color-coded distress category cards with realistic road surface vector illustrations, severity tiers (Low, Medium, High), and treatment rules: 1) Potholes (Class D40 - Depth >25mm, cold-mix/hot-mix patching); 2) Alligator / Fatigue Cracking (Class D20 - Interconnected polygon cracks, structural base failure); 3) Longitudinal & Transverse Cracks (Class D00/D10 - Thermal joint movement, crack sealing); 4) Rutting & Wheel-Path Depressions (Class D30 - Bitumen plastic deformation, mill-and-inlay); 5) Ravelling & Stripping (Class D43 - Moisture stripping, slurry seal / micro-surfacing); 6) Edge Drop-offs & Shoulder Breaks (Class D44 - Embankment erosion, berm reconstitution). Bottom panel illustrates the 0-100 Pavement Condition Index (PCI) dial from Red (0-25 Failed) to Dark Green (85-100 Good). Clean 2D flat vector aesthetic, crisp lines, professional civil engineering typography.

title: Multi-Criteria Road Maintenance Prioritisation Matrix & Budget Allocation Engine
prompt: A master engineering decision framework infographic in 16:9 widescreen format on a clean white blueprint background illustrating MULTI-CRITERIA ROAD MAINTENANCE PRIORITISATION MATRIX & BUDGET ALLOCATION ENGINE. The header displays bold dark navy typography ALGORITHMIC HIGHWAY REPAIR OPTIMISATION ENGINE with subtitle Objective Resource Allocation Under IRC:82-2015 Civil Guidelines. The diagram depicts four weighted decision input pillars converging into a central Algorithmic Prioritisation Core: 1) Pillar 1 (35% Weight - Royal Blue): Pavement Condition & Distress Severity (Pothole density, crack area, PCI index 0-100); 2) Pillar 2 (25% Weight - Cyan): Traffic Volume & Road Hierarchy (National Highway vs State Highway, Commercial Vehicles per Day CVPD, Passenger Car Units); 3) Pillar 3 (20% Weight - Emerald Green): Monsoon & Flood Vulnerability (Assam river basin proximity, annual flood immersion risk, drainage slope); 4) Pillar 4 (20% Weight - Amber): Economic Optimization & Life-Cycle Cost (Timely preventative maintenance vs structural reconstruction cost savings). Outputs three clear action streams: Urgent Safety Patching (48h), Preventative Surface Dressing, and Structural Overlay. Clean 2D flat vector aesthetic, dark navy, cyan, emerald green, and amber badges, mathematical formulation formulas, ultra-sharp typography.
